notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: [p]* Fixed an issue where dialogue would continue when selecting an actor set as a combat mission in a quest.[/p][p]* Fixed an issue where the inventory window would activate when switching from normal to combat mode using the tab key in-game (F1 to F5 hotkey mapping)[/p][p]* Fixed an issue where the client packaging size was increasing significantly (4GB => 1GB)[/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
* Changed default English voice (using Gemini TTS)
* Fixed an issue where the previous voice/start voice part of the dialogue was cut off
* Fixed an issue where dialogue was cut off in Shorts resolution when outputting dialogue (added a separate option for Shorts output)
* Fixed an issue where actors were not being created at the camera position when adding actors while using the drone camera in the quest editor
* Fixed an issue where a new channel had to be manually added when cutting video channel clips in the video editor (Recycle Bin channel is now automatically added)
* Fixed an issue where crashes occasionally occurred when cutting video channel clips in the video editor

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:

* Removed language setting for editing in Quest/NPC Studio and unified with language setting in Options window

notes.title: Update Notes : NPC Workshop Support
notes.notes:
We've added the ability to share NPCs created with generative AI through the Workshop. You can quickly and easily share your own NPCs and import NPCs created by other creators. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194011/2c42dae5bb2a85b402ce51e3866bf91b948cca7e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194011/c7e7d7e2ab112be65c0ed5ac6aead71546bf7d28.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194011/6e7e6053f4d4d6c15251db0a8ff9bbb345e0ecdb.png[/img]

Shareable NPC properties include all assets created with Generative AI, including thumbnails, models, audio, and more.

P.S.: This is a key feature that will be featured in the Indie Showcase at the G-STAR 2024 game show and is open for pre-testing. (G-STAR 2024 will take place November 14-17 in South Korea)
